description.ja: 2021年４月に地上波にてアニメ放送開始の『86－エイティシックス－』より、ヒロイン「レーナ」を立体化！
description.en: The heroine "Lena " from " 86-Eighty Six-", which will start airing on terrestrial TV in 20214, has been made into a three-dimensional figure!

description.ja: ■表情パーツは「通常顔」「笑顔」「怒り顔」の３種類選択式。ポージングに合わせた表情を楽しめる。
description.en: • There are three types of facial expressions to choose from: "normal face," " smiling face," and " angry face." You can enjoy the expressions that match the poses.

description.ja: ■髪の毛の一部を折れにくい素材（AFX）で成形し、長髪ながら自然なポージングが可能。ポーズに合わせて髪の形状を変化させることができる。
description.en: • Part of the hair is molded from break-resistant material (AFX), allowing for natural poses even with long hair. You can change the shape of your hair to match the pose.

description.ja: ■「レーナ」が被っている印象的な帽子はあり/なしの状態をパーツの選択式で再現できる。
description.en: • The impressive hat worn by "Lena" can be reproduced with or without by selecting parts.

accessories.ja: 手首パーツ　平手（左右）、バインダー用持ち手（左）、帽子用持ち手（左）
accessories.en: Wrist parts Open hands (left and right), binder handle (left), hat handle (left)

accessories.ja: 台座ジョイントパーツ×1
